identityMap.notes: Durable anonymous subject is persisted only when consent allows it; denied consent returns no anonymous visitor id.
Guest events are batched with client identity and must remain recoverable instead of being discarded at login.
Server anon session key is a transport fallback; canonical anonymous visitor id prefers the client anonymous subject when valid.
Authenticated telemetry writes observed runtime facts; identity_linked is diagnostic only and does not create an association.
The canonical caller-bound, request-consent-gated route writes associations without scanning or rewriting old guest facts; source readiness does not prove deployed or historical continuity.
Admin snapshots are UI/display read models; they can expose linked context only when first-party source labels prove it.

transferGaps.currentState: Guest events remain guest-lane facts in analytics_guest_batches and behavioral timeline facts.
transferGaps.expectedState: Guest history should be recoverable through identity lineage without rewriting guest event actor lanes.
transferGaps.action: Keep transfer implementation link-based and avoid backfilling guest rows into user rows.

transferGaps.currentState: Admin display truth reads snapshots/hot caches and first-party facts, but this inventory does not prove every UI reads identity lineage.
transferGaps.expectedState: Admin UI should show linked guest-to-user context only when source labels include identity lineage evidence.
transferGaps.action: After transfer wiring, add admin snapshot fields that distinguish direct user facts from linked guest context.

Asset observations support deduped/finalized playback time and missing-watch diagnostics.
Page dwell can diagnose engagement but must not populate canonical watch time.

sourceTruthMap.notes: Guest batches are product truth for anonymous behavior, not disposable pre-auth noise.
Lineage indexes link identities and must preserve original actor lanes.
Snapshots are fast display truth and need source labels/freshness before UI can claim health.
External analytics layers validate or compare; they do not define product identity truth.

costFindings.detail: Guest ingest has body-size, event-count, consent, idempotent batch, and transaction boundaries; future transfer must not add eager broad reads before validation.
costFindings.action: Keep identity transfer write-once per auth transition and avoid repeated 4xx retries or unbounded fanout.

costFindings.detail: Identified ingest is auth-gated, rate-limited and validates observed event batches; identity_linked remains diagnostic and cannot write associations.
costFindings.action: Keep association writes in the existing caller-bound, request-consent-gated /api/analytics/identity-link route; retain bounded diagnostic ingest.

costFindings.detail: Cloud SQL/Data Connect appears as an agent-context mirror, not as an analytics identity transfer runtime dependency.
costFindings.action: Do not invent Cloud SQL fixes; verify billing/runtime status only in a cloud-cost owner pass.

costFindings.detail: Gemini/Vertex model references are admin/AI cover/debug lanes; no analytics identity transfer model call was found.
costFindings.action: Do not add AI calls to identity transfer. Keep provider checks in the admin AI cost lane.

costFindings.detail: 401 unauthenticated and ignored invalid/payload-too-large analytics submissions are expected product 4xx/ignored paths.
costFindings.action: Clients should not retry auth-required or invalid analytics payloads indefinitely.

costFindings.detail: Malformed identity/event payloads, stale route targets, or consent/identity mismatch would be unexpected tracking/client 4xx sources during transfer wiring.
costFindings.action: Transfer implementation should emit one idempotent identity_linked event and stop retries after typed ignored/auth failures.

nextFixOrder: Keep the source-checked AuthContext handoff and sole canonical association writer; deployed continuity and historical recovery still require their own current evidence.
Verify admin/user analytics consumers label direct user facts versus consent-eligible linked guest context without double-counting or promoting missing data to zero.
